name: Graphite Work Token
description: Bind-mounts the host ~/.graphite-work-token file into the container and installs it at $HOME/.graphite-work-token (mode 600, owned by $_REMOTE_USER) at postCreate time. Paired with dotfiles that run `gt auth --token` from that file. Mount target is under /var to avoid being shadowed by /tmp tmpfs overlays (e.g., from docker-in-docker).
